recipes.title: Homemade Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.summary: A one-pot broccoli cheddar soup starts with a butter, onion, and garlic roux, then simmers chopped broccoli and shredded carrots in chicken broth and half and half. Off the heat, freshly shredded sharp cheddar is stirred in until the soup is melted and creamy.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Nuggets with Spicy Cane's-Style Sauce
recipes.summary: Ground chicken breast is seasoned, shaped into nuggets, and frozen, then dipped in a light batter and fried at 350°F until golden and crisp. Serve them hot with a spicy mayonnaise sauce flavored with sriracha and Worcestershire.

recipes.title: Homemade Chili
recipes.summary: A crowd-sized pot of chili built from browned ground beef and Italian sausage, peppers, fire-roasted tomatoes, and beans, then slow-simmered and finished with dark chocolate and a cinnamon stick. Serve it with shredded cheese, sliced jalapeños, and cornbread.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with onion, carrot, celery, beans, green beans, and small pasta simmered in an herb-flecked tomato broth. Finish each bowl with parsley, a pinch of red pepper flakes, and optional Parmesan.

recipes.title: Homemade Mac N Cheese Dry Mix
recipes.summary: A pantry jar of cheddar cheese powder, nutritional yeast, and spices that stands in for boxed mac and cheese. Whisk the mix into any drained pasta with a splash of water or milk for a creamy sauce in minutes.
